findings.finding: The bounded deadline uses Date.now via the injected clock. Wall-clock rollback during the wait extends the deadline, and a clock that does not advance while wait resolves can loop indefinitely. The safety requirement promises at most one policy interval; a monotonic elapsed-time source should bound that duration, with a test that proves clock adjustment cannot extend it.
findings.evidence: tests/browser/native-resource-boundary.mjs: awaitNativeResourceHealth sets deadline = clock() + intervalMs and compares deadline - clock() after each await wait(...). Production defaults clock to Date.now.
